summary: Derived cash-flow summaries in underwriting-api have no owner and no retention classification. Document ingestion records both. The retention job deletes raw documents only, and nothing records how long a deletion audit event is kept.

findings.rationale: The cash-flow summary comment says the row has no owner, and the insert does not write one.

evidence.rationale: The file states that the row has no owner.

proposedTasks.title: Record an owner on each cash-flow summary
proposedTasks.acceptanceCriteria: The persisted summary includes an owner that a reviewer can name.

findings.rationale: The insert writes application id, inflow, and captured date. It does not write a retention classification id.

evidence.rationale: The inserted columns do not include a classification id.

proposedTasks.title: Store the policy classification id on the summary
proposedTasks.acceptanceCriteria: The row stores a classification id that exists in the policy config.

findings.rationale: The extracted artifact sets owner to the document-platform constant.
The artifact stores the classification id derived-underwriting-summary. The duration for that id is only in the policy config.

evidence.rationale: The classification id constant is declared here.

findings.rationale: Coverage is the raw-bank-document classification. The comment says derived cash-flow summaries are not in the list.

evidence.rationale: The coverage list and the comment exclude derived summaries.

proposedTasks.title: Add derived underwriting summaries to deletion coverage
proposedTasks.acceptanceCriteria: The coverage list includes the derived-underwriting-summary classification id.

findings.rationale: The job returns a deletion audit event. Neither this file nor the policy config says how long that audit record is kept.

evidence.rationale: An audit event is returned, and the function does not record a retention period.

unknowns: The retention period of the deletion audit record is not in the policy config or this file.

unresolvedQuestions: Where is the retention period of a deletion audit record defined?
